purpose.domain_detail: University or vocational COBOL course exercise matching employees with their sales records (apareo = merge/match)
purpose.summary: Batch program that performs a sequential file match (apareo) between an EMPLOYEES file and a SALES file, both sorted by employee ID. It accumulates sales amounts per active employee and writes matched records to an output file, while logging unmatched or inactive-employee records to an error file. Counters for each file are displayed at end of run.

notable_features: Sequential file match (apareo) algorithm with sentinel value 99999999
DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA for European numeric formatting
COPY copybooks for output record layouts (APAREO and ERROR)
88-level condition names for file status codes
EVALUATE TRUE with multiple WHEN clauses for match/no-match cases
Structured paragraph naming convention (1000/2000/3000 hierarchy with -FIN exit paragraphs)
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; the CLOSE statement at the end is cut off. Program is clearly a student exercise authored by Gabriela C Rodriguez on 25/09/2023. Spanish-language identifiers and comments throughout. The inline ASCII-art case labels (Caso1, Caso2, Caso3) in the EVALUATE block are unusual but valid as comment lines.
